WITH A61_Patents AS (
  SELECT 
    p.publication_number,
    p.assignee,
    YEAR(TO_DATE(CAST(p.filing_date AS STRING), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS filing_year

    s.totals.pageviews AS pageviews,
    IF(s.totals.transactions >= 1 AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM UNNEST(s.hits) h,

    IF(s.totals.transactions IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (

WITH FilteredPatents AS (
  -- Step 1: Filter US B2 utility patents granted between 2010 and 2014
  SELECT 
    p.publication_number,
    p.filing_date,
    p.grant_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE(p.filing_date)) AS filing_year,
    p.citation
  FROM 
    PATENTS_GOOGLE.PATENTS_GOOGLE.PUBLICATIONS p
  WHERE 
    p.country_code = 'US'
    AND p.kind_code = 'B2'
    AND DATE(p.grant_date) BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
),
ForwardCitations AS (
  -- Step 2: Count forward citations within one month of filing date
  SELECT 
    fp.publication_number,
    fp.filing_date,
    fp.grant_date,
    fp.filing_year,
    COUNT(c.cited_by_pub_num) AS forward_citation_count
  FROM 
    FilteredPatents fp,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => fp.citation) c
  WHERE 
    c.cited_by_pub_num IS NOT NULL
    AND DATE(c.cited_by_date) <= DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATE(fp.filing_date))
    AND DATE(c.cited_by_date) >= DATE(fp.filing_date)
  GROUP BY 
    fp.publication_number,
    fp.filing_date,
    fp.grant_date,
    fp.filing_year
),
TopPatent AS (
  -- Step 3: Select the patent with the most forward citations (tie-breaker: earliest filing date)
